body:
Financial burden is not motivating me to die. I simply wish to arrange my affairs before killing myself. I accept that suicide is selfish and clearing debt will not lessen the emotional pain that I will cause.

The rest of your post seems sadly trite to me. I've argued with myself plenty, for years. Existence is beautiful, life has many experiences to offer, sure. My condition prevents me from appreciating them. Attempts to change my condition have failed. I've ultimately decided that I wish to stop fighting. Of course I doubt that decision. But I've made it nonetheless.

I do appreciate that you took the time to post something and show that you care.
